generalJokes:
- What did the big tomato say to the little tomato lagging behind? 
 - Ketchup!

- How does a snowman get so good at waiting? 
 - He just has to chill!

- Why did the gum refuse to rush? 
 - Because it wanted to stick around and see what would bubble up!
- I was going to tell you a time management joke... but I ran out of time.

- Why are elevator jokes so good? 
 - They work on many levels, but you’ve got to wait for them!
- I told my wife she should embrace her mistakes. She gave me a hug.
- I told a bad chemistry joke once. I got no reaction.

- How do you make time fly? 
 - Throw your watch out the window.

- Why was the calendar so stressed? 
 - It had too many dates.
- Waiting for a slow computer is like watching an ice age thaw. It’s byte by byte.

- What’s the best thing to do while you’re waiting for a slow website to load? 
 - Read a book... or write one! (you can do that here).

- What do you call a factory that makes okay products? 
 - A satisfactory.

- How do you organize a space party? 
 - You planet.

- What do you call an inventor’s mistakes? 
 - A new feature.

- Why don’t scientists trust atoms when they’re producing new materials? 
 - Because they make up everything!

- What does a clock do when it’s hungry? 
 - It goes back four seconds.

- Why did the man sit on his watch? 
 - He wanted to be on time.

- Why was the computer cold at the office? 
 - It left its Windows open.

- What did the digital clock say to its mother? 
 - “Look, Ma! No hands!”
imageJokes:
- Why don't artists trust sketchbooks? 
 Because something always seems to be drawn out.

- What did the designer say to their font? 
 - "You’re so bold!"

- Why did the artist break up with the pencil? 
 - It was pointless.

- Why did the paintbrush feel sad? 
 - It was in a bit of a stroke of bad luck.

- What’s an artist’s favorite martial art? 
 - Taekwondoodle.

- Why did the movie director go broke? 
 - Because they kept losing their scenes.

- How do you know an artist is a perfectionist? 
 - They can’t draw the line at one sketch.

- What did the art teacher say when the class started to get messy? 
 - "I am drawing the line here!"

- Why don’t artists play hide and seek? 
 - Because good luck hiding from someone who draws their own conclusions.

- Why did the movie studio hire a magician? 
 - For the special effects!

- What’s an artist’s favorite band? 
 - D'Sketch Mode.

- Why do film directors love elevators? 
 - They always have their ups and downs.

- Why did the artist go to jail? 
 - Because they got framed!

- Why do movie producers always carry a pencil? 
 - In case they have to draw a blank.

- Why don’t storyboard artists ever get lost? 
 - Because they always have a character to follow.

- What did the artist say when their house was messy? 
 - “It’s just a little abstract.”

- Why did the artist bring a ladder to the gallery? 
 - To reach new heights.

- Why are sketch artists always so calm? 
 - Because they always keep their lines straight.

- Why did the artist keep their studio so clean? 
 - They swept it under the canvas.

- What do you get when you mix a writer and a director? 
 - A script with direction!

- Why don’t artists ever play cards? 
 - They’re afraid of drawing the wrong hand.

- Why was the camera always calm? 
 - Because it knew how to focus.
